crossRefs.note: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send…
Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”
But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish…

translations.web: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
translations.bsb: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
